Annexure-C SCOPE OF WORK during Comprehensive Annual Maintenance Contract CAMC period (4 Years after 01 year warranty): The successful bidder shall provide 4 years Comprehensive AMC support which will start after the expiry of the warranty period or such other extended periods as the contract terms may provide. During the period of warranty or such other extended periods, the defective goods are to be replaced free of cost by the sup plier and as such maintenance contract on payment basis should commence onl y after warranty period. Bidder shall sign ACCEPTANCE of CAMC condition and upload the signed copies for participating in this BID. Repair/replacement/servicing shall mean system testing, repair and maintenanc e of entire/total equipment for proper functioning of Automation system of Dies el bowser. The 4 year CAMC after one year warranty period includes repairing & maintenance of all the equipment like Electronic Flow meter, Electronic Counter , Wireless gateway terminal, Data Transfer Modem/ Router, Nozzle reader, ATG system and all other items/equipment associated with the system. The Guarant ee/ Warranty/ CAMC period charges also include the expenses for preventive m aintenance and routine check-up and attending to breakdown calls as and when required.

Special conditions of CAMC are: A. Warranty/CAMC period shall cover year-round support and facilities for the com plete solution (both hardware and software) for ensuring at least 95% uptime of the system and thus avoiding downtime beyond permissible limit. Service shall also include replacement of hardware components, software/firmware updates and upgrades, and other service related activities to keep the system updated with current/evolving technologies. B. Bidder to submit renewal copy of PESO approval of the equipment (RFID Rings/ Tags, RFID Reader, Batch Controller, ATG, Solenoid Valve periodically during CA MC Period. C. Sufficient replacement spares is to be maintained to cater to any complaints/do wntime issues within specified time period. Arrangement of hand tools & tackles, special tools, skill manpower/expert etc. required to carry out the work, cost of the spares replaced and service charge shall be under the scope of the C AMC. D. Connectivity for achieving real time data access, alerts, reports and zero data l oss with minimum downtime shall be ensured during CAMC period. Fine tuning f or improving the system shall be done during the CAMC period as per ECL’s req uirement. E. The scope of CAMC includes providing adequate manpower with help desk to e nsure efficient working of the entire system by resolving all system related prob lems. Refresher training, if required, shall be provided to ECL personnel at regul ar intervals or annually. F. Mode of communication in case of any issue shall be conveyed through phone/ email/WhatsApp or shall be recorded in specified complaint portal provided by b idder. G. The repair works shall be carried out at the ECL premises. However in case the equipment is to be taken elsewhere for repair, the bidder shall carry and deliver the equipment back after repairing at their own cost and risk and also ensuring the minimum required uptime of the system. H. This contracts will also cover the Services/Subscriptions related to data storage in Cloud server & its data sharing with ECL SAP/ERP and replacement of non-fun ctioning RFID Rings/tag also. I. Any modification/updating of software for the change in class of service and to provide some additional facilities within the existing software system shall be co vered under 4 year CAMC after one year warranty period.

J. In case of delay in attending to problems, breakdown of system/component du e to improper handling by service provider or any other activity which leads to d owntime of the system beyond permissible limit, suitable penalties shall be levied as per the Penalty Clauses. K. Whenever the situation arises “The purchaser reserves its right to terminate th e maintenance contract at any time without assigning any reason. The contract or will not be entitled to claim any compensation against such termination. How ever, while terminating the contract, if any payment is due to the contractor for maintenance services already performed in terms of the contract, the same wo uld be paid to it as per the contract terms”. If the situation arises, bidder has to transfer the whole automation system and its equipment from one Diesel bowse r to other and their installation & commissioning charges will be borne by ECL. L. Penalty Charges in Warranty/CAMC period: The bidder shall guarantee 95 % uptime shall be maintained on Bowser Automation system. In case if downtime exceeds 5% then penalty charges will be collected from the bidder at the rate of Rs 200 per bowser per day. Penalty will be calculated on quarterly basis for all t he Bowsers put together in each mine based on the time elapse between loggin g a call/ placing of service request and satisfactory resolution/ rectification of ea ch Bowser complaint. Penalty calculated will be included for recovery from the quarterly bill. M. Penalty calculations will be as under: (A) Total Bowser downtime in the mine for the quarter in days. (B) Permitted Downtime (5%) for Bowser in the mine put to gether for the quarter = No: of Bowser in mine * No: of days in the quarter * 0.0 5 (C) Penalty = (A – B) * Rs. 200.00 per Bowser. (D) Penalty calculated at (C) sh all be recovered from the quarterly CAMC bill. There shall be no penalty if the to tal Bowser downtime (A) is within the permitted limits as calculated at (B). (E) Maximum penalty for a Bowser shall be limited to quarterly CAMC invoice value of the individual Bowser. N. Scheduled periodical preventive maintenance including calibration shall be don e once in a quarter and shall not hamper the normal functioning of the system. O. CAMC charges shall be paid on quarterly basis after completion of each quarter . Quarterly CAMC bill along with penalty charges, if any and Service report signe d by the ECL in-charge shall be submitted for payment process. P. During the entire CAMC period, ECL can request additional functionalities like d ata consolidation and data in required format which is functionally within the en visaged scope and the additional functionalities shall be delivered without additi onal cost to ECL. Q. The number of vehicles/equipment may change during the period of contract. RFID tags for new vehicles/equipment shall be fixed and incorporated into the s ystem as per instruction of ECL officials on chargeable basis.
